title: Renewal storyboard: Skyline Retail strategic checkpoint - H2 renewal
content:
Audience: Skyline Retail executive sponsors (CTO, Head of Platform), product owners, and engineering leads
Meeting length: 45 minutes (30 min presentation + 15 min discussion)
Presenter: Avery Chen (CS lead) with Jordan Patel (solutions eng) for technical deep-dive

Purpose:
- Align on renewal value and roadmap alignment for H2 2026 contract.
- Surface open risks (latency incidents, embedding spend), agree mitigations and timeline for Dedicated migration pilot.
- Secure commitment for a 12-month reserved capacity contract with an initial 6-week migration pilot and commercial terms to follow.

Meeting logistics & pre-reads:
- Share link to dashboard snapshot 48 hours before the meeting (observability: /dash/skyline/summary).
- Ask attendees to flag any operational incidents they want covered.
- Pre-meeting poll: priority ranking (latency, cost, compliance, uptime) — include results slide.

Slide-by-slide narrative (speaker notes):
1) Title / One-sentence ask (30s)
- Script: "Thanks all for joining. Today’s goal: review outcomes since onboarding, discuss clustered risks, and agree the pilot and renewal next steps so Skyline can get predictable latency and lower per-token costs next quarter."
- Visual: Skyline logo + renewal ask summary box (pilot -> Dedicated -> reserved capacity)

2) Where we started (2 min)
- Script: "6 months ago Skyline started on Hosted API for rapid feature rollout (search rerank + personalized snippets). Initial goals were speed-to-market and proof-of-value."
- Data bullets: time-to-first-feature: 3 weeks; initial 99th pctl latency on hosted: 420–520ms for 2k tokens; initial embedding monthly spend $12k

3) What changed (3 min)
- Script: "Customer shipped 3 major features using Redwood: personalized home feed (A/B +8% CTR), search relevancy lift (NDCG +12%), and summarization for CS tickets (latency-critical)."
- Highlight wins with concrete metrics.
content_addendum:
(Note to self: pull final NDCG numbers from evals board; Jordan to validate embedding spike cause)

4) Current health snapshot (3 min)
- Headline: Usage growth 2.3x QoQ, 30-day error rate ~0.6%, 99th pctl latency trending down after auto-batching.
- Risk flags: short tail latency incidents around peak hours; embedding cost growth driven by export pipeline.
- Visual: small table (tokens, reqs/s, avg latency, cost/mo, active routes)

5) Customer success story (1.5 min)
- Script: "Examples of product improvements tied to Redwood: search CTR +8% = estimated $250k ARR impact, CS summarization reduced TTR by 12%"

6) Key operational incident timeline (2.5 min)
- Script: "Two incidents in last 90 days: a 30-min throughput degradation on 2026-01-11 (root cause: autoscale policy mismatch), and intermittent 99th pctl spikes on 2026-02-04 traced to a client-side retry storm."
- Action taken: temporary burst pool, updated client SDK retry guidance, patch to autoscale config.

7) Why Dedicated matters for Skyline (3 min)
- Script: "Dedicated gives predictable throughput and latency SLOs and lets you pin model versions for stable behavior during peak holiday traffic. It also provides isolation for export pipelines that are driving embedding spend."
- Visual: quick cost vs predictability chart + proposed performance SLA (99% requests < 200ms for core generate route)

8) Proposed pilot plan (4 min)
- 6-week timeline: week 0-1 provisioning & access, weeks 2-3 baseline benchmarking (latency & throughput), week 4 migration of 1 route (CS summarization), week 5 smoke tests + rollback validation, week 6 go/no-go review.
- Success criteria: 10% latency improvement at P99, embedding cost per unit reduced by 15%, zero production regressions in quality as measured by eval prompt-set.

9) Commercial ask & options (2 min)
- Option A (preferred): 12-month reserved capacity after successful pilot, monthly invoice, 10% committed discount, 2-week support SLA.
- Option B: 6-month pilot-only with on-demand credit commitment.
- Script: "Recommend A if pilot meets criteria; if not, we agree on a 3-month follow-up plan."

10) Risk register & mitigations (3 min)
- List: embedding cost creep (mitigation: quantization + export cadence changes), client retry storms (mitigation: SDK auto-backoff + rate limiter), model quality regressions (mitigation: eval baseline + canary rollouts).

11) Tailored talking points for execs (1.5 min)
- For CTO: emphasize predictable latency and roadmap alignment (pin models, dedicated pool).
- For Head of Platform: emphasize reduced ops overhead and fewer incident escalations.
- For Product: emphasize direct revenue/CTR gains and faster iteration cycles.

12) Open decisions we need today (1 min)
- Confirm pilot start date (propose Mar 15, 2026).
- Confirm decision owner for go/no-go (recommend: Head of Platform).
- Confirm acceptance of proposed SLA targets for pilot success metrics.

13) Appendix / technical deep dive (optional drop-in if asked)
- Jordan to lead: benchmarking methodology (p99 sampling, KV cache priming, prefix reuse), model variant mapping, and rollback checklist.

Speaker cues / probing questions (for discussion):
- "Which outcome matters most to you in the next quarter: cost, latency, or predictability?"
- "If we could guarantee a 15% reduction in embedding cost, would that change your renewal preference?"
- "Are there internal launch dates (holiday promos) that drive immovable deadlines?"

Playbook checklist (post-meeting):
- Share recording + slide deck within 24 hours (Avery)
- Send final pilot runbook and access checklist (Jordan)
- Finance to share draft SOW and comms plan (Riya)
- CS to create incident-runbook template for Skyline (Samir)

Open / TODOs (notes to self):
- Pull exact NDCG and revenue linkage numbers (dataset: evals/skyline/q1-2026) — action Jordan
- Confirm embedding export cadence and why cost spiked Feb 2 — action Riya to engage data eng
- Draft SOW template with milestone payments tied to pilot metrics — action Avery + finance
- Add a short config diff comparing current hosted config vs. proposed Dedicated pool config for their infra team to review

Appendix: short script for product demo clip (30s)
- Script: "Here’s a quick demo of the personalized home feed improvement: with Redwood’s realtime reranker, we see faster relevance and lower compute per recommendation. Result: higher CTR and lower compute cost per session."

Quick reference for internal reviewers:
- Recommended reviewers: Jordan (solutions eng), Riya (finance lead), Samir (SRE).
- Suggested slack thread: #cs-skyline-renewal.
